This contribution is just part of your other one:
https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/146304dd65a9c9b75663005e8812face752949

If you want to keep this one, please remove that one.

Constraints
* Please change 1000000000 to 10⁹.

Cases
* Please reorder the first three pairs of cases:
  - Test 1: 12345
  - Validator 1: 38
  - Test 2: 10
  - Validator 2: 20
  - Test 3: 0
  - Validator 3: 7

* Please add a new pair of cases where the expected output is 3.

Thanks.
